description: Portrait of O'Keeffe standing in the corner of her adobe walled courtyard; O'Keeffe stands in the doorway wearing a long black coat and a black cap-like hood; large diagonal shadow running across bottom half of photograph; triangular shadow in upper left corner of doorway; paving stones, well-head wooden cover and window visible in foreground.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe, Courtyard, Abiquiu
